ports.name: Captain Claw
ports.notes: OpenClaw engine port. Supply your own CLAW.REZ from the original 1997 game. Levels 1-7 (all OpenClaw implements) are playable; no music, as the game's MIDI needs a synth this build deliberately omits. Hold MENU to quit.

ports.name: Mini Tracker
ports.notes: Backlog and play-time tracker that runs on the handheld; reads Onion's play activity read-only, box-art grid. All devices.

ports.name: Petals Around the Rose
ports.notes: Standalone dice logic puzzle port for Miyoo Mini and Miyoo A30.

ports.name: Jazz Jackrabbit 2
ports.notes: Jazz² Resurrection engine port. Supply your own copy of the game; a Windows converter is included in the download. Steady 30 FPS, sound, music and cinematics; single-player only, and the textured backgrounds are drawn flat because the effect cost a third of the frame.

ports.name: Tennis vs Zombies
ports.notes: Original indie action tennis survival game running natively at 60 FPS with full studio soundtrack.

ports.name: Mines of Moria
ports.notes: Descend the Mines of Moria, level by level, and slay the Balrog waiting at the bottom. Rufe.org's rebuild of Umoria, itself the 1983 roguelike by Robert Alan Koeneke that Angband and much of the genre grew out of: permadeath, a randomly generated dungeon on every stairway, a town to spend your gold in between dives. This build uses the graphical client, with sprite tiles and a map that fills the screen. Press Start for the in-game menu, where the tile renderer, magnification and colours can all be changed.

ports.name: Monk Tower
ports.notes: A simple coffee-break roguelike game. Roam through 20 levels of the cloister tower, to retrieve the lost manuscript. Carefully manage your weapons, as they get damaged quicker than you think. Separate packages for OnionOS, spruceOS and Allium.

ports.name: Minecraft: Bedrock Edition 1.2
ports.notes: Bedrock 1.2.20.2 through the minecraft-linux launcher on a software GL stack. Mini Plus only. No GPU, so 6-8 fps: choose 160x120 at the launch prompt, and relaunch at 320x240 if you need the Settings or Store buttons. Supply your own Android APK.

ports.name: CPU Overclock
ports.notes: Pick a CPU clock from a simple list; the app detects Mini versus Mini Plus on its own and writes the setting into the RetroArch and NDS configs. Mini tops out at 1600 MHz, Mini Plus at 1800 MHz. The App/CpuOverclock folder on the SD card must be named exactly that or the icon will not show.
ports.why: no releases: build it from its repository

ports.name: Pico-8 Wrapper
ports.notes: Runs the native Pico-8 fantasy console with Splore and realtime overclocking (Select + Up/Down). Mini and Mini Plus. Supply your own purchased Raspberry Pi pico8_dyn and pico8.dat from Lexaloffle.
ports.why: its repository is gone or private

ports.name: retsurf
ports.notes: A web browser built on the Servo engine, designed for gamepad navigation. Features include Vimium-style link hints, an on-screen keyboard, tabs, bookmarks, reader mode, and downloads.

ports.name: Balatro
ports.notes: Rust compatibility runtime for the LÖVE game. Supply your own Balatro.love; the first launch prepares audio. Runs at 1.5 GHz via Onion's clock helper.

ports.name: Fallout
ports.notes: fallout1-ce port with a full D-pad/button control scheme. Supply your own master.dat, critter.dat, and data folder.

ports.name: Fallout 2
ports.notes: Based on the actively maintained FOR:CE fork, not the original fallout2-ce. Native mod support, including the Restoration Project. Supply your own master.dat, critter.dat, and data folder.

ports.name: 3D Pinball Space Cadet
ports.notes: k4zmu2a decompilation. Supply PINBALL.DAT, FONT.DAT, and all SOUND*.WAV files from the original Windows install.

ports.name: Insaniquarium Deluxe
ports.notes: Native port of the PopCap game. Copy data/, fishsongs/, images/, music/, properties/ and sounds/ from your own PC copy of Insaniquarium Deluxe into Roms/PORTS/Games/Insaniquarium/. Smooth on the Mini Flip with synchronized audio; Mini and Mini Plus are untested, and the launcher's input device path is set for the Flip.

ports.name: Tomb Raider
ports.notes: OpenLara engine with a rebuilt dual-core software renderer; Tomb Raider 1 only. Requires the GOG version (Tomb Raider 1+2+3): supply GAME.GOG (required, the game data is extracted from it on first start) and, optionally, the 02.mp3 to 10.mp3 music files.

ports.name: Mixtape
ports.notes: App store for this collection: browse, install and update ports on the device. Mini Plus/Flip (WiFi).

ports.name: Rewind
ports.notes: New-on-streaming movie guide with Rotten Tomatoes/IMDb scores and trailer QR codes; optional Radarr. Mini Plus/Flip (WiFi); needs free TMDB and OMDb API keys.

ports.name: Panel Attack
ports.notes: Unofficial, modified port of Panel Attack by the Panel Attack team (panelattack.com); not supported by them, so report bugs to the port's GitHub. Endless, puzzles, time attack, vs CPU. Online play is off for now. Installs to Ports.

ports.name: MiniAmp
ports.notes: Classic-skin music player: MP3/FLAC/OGG/WAV, .wsz skins, EQ, visualizers. Optional music in games (swaps Onion's libpadsp.so; turning it off restores the original).

ports.name: Miyoo Better Favorites
ports.notes: Favorites grouped by console, scrolling titles and optional Home access/GameSwitcher return. Use the included computer installer. Tested on Mini Plus with Onion 4.3.1-1; other devices unverified.

ports.name: UFO 50
ports.notes: Development build for OnionOS. Copy your Windows UFO 50 game files to Roms/PORTS/Games/UFO50/gamefiles, with data.win directly inside.

ports.name: Hexen II
ports.notes: uHexen2 (Hammer of Thyrion) with the original software renderer spread over both cores; 640x480 3D view, 50-60 FPS. Requires the GOG version: supply everything in its data1 folder (required) and, optionally, its music folder (Track02.ogg to Track17.ogg) for the CD soundtrack.

ports.name: SkiFree
ports.notes: Based on the SkiFree decompilation and Slayer366's SDL2 source port. Ready to run: extract the zip to the SD card root, nothing to supply. 60 fps at the original game speed (Menu+Start switches to the original 25 fps); High Scores with name entry (Menu+Select).

ports.name: Zuma Deluxe
ports.notes: Untested on the original Mini. Copy your PC assets to Roms/PORTS/Games/Zuma Deluxe/ or use the launcher.py on PC.

ports.name: Mario Kart 64
ports.notes: jnmartin84's mk64-dc (Dreamcast port of the Mario Kart 64 decompilation) with a dual-core software renderer: 640x480, 60 FPS single-player races, no overclock. Supply your own Mario Kart 64 (USA) ROM (.z64, .n64, .v64 or zipped); the game data is built from it on the first start. Save states and Game Switcher.

ports.name: Plants vs. Zombies GOTY Edition
ports.notes: Untested on the original Mini. Extract the release, then copy your PC main.pak to Roms/PORTS/Games/Plants vs. Zombies/, keeping the bundled properties/ folder. Or use Launcher.py on PC.
ports.why: its release ships files from the original game (properties/partner.xml, partner_logo.jpg)

ports.name: Scorched Earth
ports.notes: Scorched Earth 1.5's own DOS exe, statically recompiled to native ARM code: the original game, not a remake. The zip includes the shareware version, unmodified; extract it to the SD card root. Tested on a Mini Plus; untested on the original Mini.

ports.name: MiYooSDR
ports.notes: Mini Plus only (it needs the built-in Wi-Fi chip). A receive-only 2.4 GHz spectrum analyzer and waterfall from the chip's own spectrum engine, with zoom down to 5 MHz and CSV recording. Wi-Fi is off while it runs.

ports.name: Grand Theft Auto
ports.notes: The original 1997 Windows exe, run by box86 and a shell that stands in for the Windows parts it calls. Copy WINO, GTADATA and Music from Rockstar's 2002 freeware release. No intro movie or network play. Tested on a Mini Plus; untested on the original Mini.

ports.name: Bible
ports.notes: Bible reader with button controls: KJV + WEB, red letters, adjustable text size, night mode, remembers your place. The International download on the release page includes all 60 translations.

ports.name: Overclock
ports.notes: CPU clock for all systems or per system, with green/yellow/orange zones from Onion's limits and one-button restore. Overclocking can cause crashes and freezes; use at your own risk.
